title: Madhya-khanda, part 7 (portion 30)
html:
The section "Pastimes with the Devotees and the Deliverance of Jagai and Madhai": the devotees place on their heads the water of Nityananda's feet; Haridasa in the form of Brahma; the arrival of Advaita; the Lord speaks of the reasons for His descent; He bids the devotees give the holy name from house to house; the sins of Jagai and Madhai; sankirtana through the town; the brothers wound Nityananda; the Lord summons Sudarshana, and Nityananda pleads for the offenders

Pastimes with the Devotees and the Deliverance of Jagai and Madhai

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. One day, when Sriman Mahaprabhu was sporting in the bliss of prema with the devotees headed by Srivasa, Haridasa, Murari and Mukunda, Sriman Nityananda Prabhu came there. At Sriman Mahaprabhu's command the devotees placed on their heads the water of Sriman Nityananda Prabhu's feet and [began] to dance in the bliss of prema. When Haridasa and Sriman Advaita Prabhu came there, [Haridasa] offered Him praise; then Sriman Mahaprabhu rose together with the devotees and showed him due honour, fed him and told him of preaching prema without distinction between the worthy and the unworthy, and commanded His devotees to go from door to door and distribute the holy name and prema. But when the devotees refused, [fearing] two great sinful brahmanas named Jagai and Madhai, Sriman Mahaprabhu Himself glorified before the devotees the greatness of the holy name — for example, the deliverance of the great sinner Ajamila by namabhasa, [the name uttered while intending another,] — and, to deliver these two sons of brahmanas, expressed His wish to go round the town Himself with the devotees, performing kirtana with mridangas and karatalas. Delighted at Sriman Mahaprabhu's words, the devotees all gathered together and began kirtana; all around resounded with the holy name. Hearing the kirtana, Jagai and Madhai in great anger began to abuse Sriman Mahaprabhu in every way; [Sriman Mahaprabhu and] Nityananda by Their own will [paid no heed] and [looked on them with mercy]. At last they struck Sri Nityananda on the head with a shard of a pot. Sriman Mahaprabhu, unable to bear [the insult and pain] of His own [devotee], summoned Sudarshana to destroy those two. Sri Nityananda Prabhu forgave Jagai and Madhai all their offences and begged for their lives, [and Mahaprabhu] cast a merciful glance on them. [By the grace] of Sri Nityananda, Jagai and Madhai were delivered and became great devotees. Then the author glorified the compassion of Nityananda and Mahaprabhu.1

Raga dhanashi; refrain: "What a wonder in the midst of Nadia! Golden Gauranga dances — a great wonder!"

হেনরূপে নবদ্বীপে বিহরে ঠাকুর ।
আপনা পাসরি' প্রেম প্রকাশে প্রচুর ॥ ১ ॥

henarūpe nabadbīpe bihare ṭhākura |
āpanā pāsari' prema prakāśe pracura || 1 ||

henarupe — thus; navadvipe vihare thakura — the Thakura sports in Navadvipa; apana pasari — forgetting Himself; prema prakashe prachura — reveals prema abundantly

1Thus the Thakura sports in Navadvipa:
forgetting Himself, He reveals prema abundantly.

স্বতন্ত্র হইয়া হয়ে ভকত-অধীন ।
সভারে যাচয়ে প্রেমা যেন মহাদীন ॥ ২ ॥

sbatantra haiẏā haẏe bhakata-adhīna |
sabhāre yācaẏe premā yena mahādīna || 2 ||

svatantra haiya — though independent; haye bhakata-adhina — He becomes subject to His devotees; sabhare yachaye prema — He offers prema to all unasked; yena mahadina — as if most humble

2Independent as He is, He becomes subject to His devotees
and, as if most humble, begs everyone to take prema.

আচম্বিতে একদিন ধন্য রম্য বেলে ।
নিজজন-সঙ্গে ক্রীড়া করে সন্ধ্যাকালে ॥ ২+১ ॥

ācambite ekadina dhanya ramya bele |
nijajana-saṅge krīṛā kare sandhyākāle || 2+1 ||

achambite — suddenly; ekadina — one day; dhanya ramya bele — at a blessed, lovely hour; nijajana-sange — with His own people; krida kare — plays; sandhya-kale — in the evening

2+1Suddenly one day, at a blessed and lovely hour,
He was playing with His own people in the evening2.

সবার অঙ্গের বস্তর নিলা ত কাড়িয়া ।
আনন্দে হাসয়ে সবে বিনয় করিয়া ॥ ২+২ ॥

sabāra aṅgera bastara nilā ta kāṛiẏā |
ānande hāsaẏe sabe binaẏa kariẏā || 2+2 ||

sabara angera bastara — the clothes from everyone's bodies; nila ta kadiya — snatched away; anande hasaye sabe — all laugh for joy; vinaya kariya — humbly beseeching

2+2He snatched away everyone's clothes,
and all, laughing for joy, humbly beseech [Him].

সব জন লজ্জায় অবশ ভেল তনু ।
করে আচ্ছাদয়ে অঙ্গ চাটু করে পুনু ॥ ২+৩ ॥

saba jana lajjāẏa abaśa bhela tanu |
kare ācchādaẏe aṅga cāṭu kare punu || 2+3 ||

saba jana — everyone; lajjaya — for shame; avasha bhela tanu — the body went weak; kare achchhadaye anga — cover the body with the hands; chatu kare punu — coax again and again

2+3For shame everyone's limbs went weak;
covering themselves with their hands, they coax [Him] again and again:

বস্ত্র দেহ বস্ত্র দেহ ত্রিজগত-রায় ।
এমন করিতে প্রভু তোরে না জুয়ায় ॥ ২+৪ ॥

bastra deha bastra deha trijagata-rāẏa |
emana karite prabhu tore nā juẏāẏa || 2+4 ||

bastra deha — give the clothes; trijagata-raya — Lord of the three worlds; emana karite — to act so; prabhu — Lord; tore na juyaya — does not befit You

2+4"Give the clothes, give the clothes, Lord of the three worlds!
It does not befit You, Lord, to act like this!"

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভুর অধিক উল্লাস ।
ক্ষণেক অন্তরে সব জনে দিল বাস ॥ ২+৫ ॥

e bola śuniẏā prabhura adhika ullāsa |
kṣaṇeka antare saba jane dila bāsa || 2+5 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing these words; prabhura adhika ullasa — the Lord's delight increased; kshaneka antare — a moment later; saba jane dila basa — gave everyone their clothes

2+5Hearing these words, the Lord grew merrier still
and a moment later gave everyone back their clothes.

এইমতে বিহরে রসিক-শিরোমণি ।
সর্বজনে রসদাতা সর্বরস জানি' ॥ ২+৬ ॥

eimate bihare rasika-śiromaṇi |
sarbajane rasadātā sarbarasa jāni' || 2+6 ||

eimate vihare — thus plays; rasika-shiromani — the crown-jewel of connoisseurs of rasa; sarvajane rasa-data — giver of rasa to all; sarva-rasa jani — knowing every rasa

2+6Thus plays the crown-jewel of connoisseurs of rasa,
the giver of rasa to all, who knows every rasa.

বস্ত্র দিয়া তুষ্ট কৈলা সব নিজজনে ।
আপনে নাচয়ে সুখে নাচে ভৃত্যগণে ॥ ২+৭ ॥

bastra diẏā tuṣṭa kailā saba nijajane |
āpane nācaẏe sukhe nāce bhṛtyagaṇe || 2+7 ||

bastra diya — giving the clothes; tushta kaila — gladdened; saba nijajane — all His own people; apane nachaye sukhe — He Himself dances joyfully; nache bhritya-gane — the servants dance

2+7Giving back the clothes, He gladdened all His own people;
He Himself dances joyfully, and His servants dance.

লীলাগতি চলে প্রভু লোক-অলক্ষিত ।
তার নিজজন জানে তাহার ইঙ্গিত ॥ ৩ ॥

līlāgati cale prabhu loka-alakṣita |
tāra nijajana jāne tāhāra iṅgita || 3 ||

lila-gati chale prabhu — the Lord moves in His lila; loka-alakshita — unnoticed by people; tara nijajana jane — His own know; tahara ingita — His hints

3The Lord moves in His lila unnoticed by people;
only His own understand His hints.

শ্রীনিবাস হরিদাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ ।
ইঙ্গিত বুঝিয়া গায় বাঢ়ে প্রেমানন্দ ॥ ৪ ॥

śrīnibāsa haridāsa murāri mukunda |
iṅgita bujhiẏā gāẏa bāṛhe premānanda || 4 ||

shrinivasa haridasa murari mukunda — Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari, Mukunda; ingita bujhiya — understanding the hint; gaya — sing; badhe premananda — the bliss of prema grows

4Srinivasa, Haridasa, Murari, Mukunda,
understanding His hint, sing, and the bliss of prema grows.

আনন্দে বিহ্বল নিজগণে নাচে গায় ।
হেনকালে আইলা পুনঃ অবধূতরায় ॥ ৫ ॥

ānande bihbala nijagaṇe nāce gāẏa |
henakāle āilā punaḥ abadhūtarāẏa || 5 ||

anande vihvala — overwhelmed with joy; nijagane nache gaya — His associates dance and sing; henakale — at that time; aila punah avadhuta-raya — the Avadhuta-raya came again

5Overwhelmed with joy, His associates dance and sing;
at that time the Avadhuta-raya came again.

অবধূত আইলা বলি' পড়ে জয় জয় ।
আনন্দে সকল লোক সুমঙ্গল গায় ॥ ৬ ॥

abadhūta āilā bali' paṛe jaẏa jaẏa |
ānande sakala loka sumaṅgala gāẏa || 6 ||

avadhuta aila bali — saying "The Avadhuta has come!"; pade jaya jaya — "Jaya, jaya!" rings out; anande sakala loka — all the people joyfully; sumangala gaya — sing auspicious songs

6"The Avadhuta has come!" — "Jaya, jaya!" rings out,
and all the people joyfully sing auspicious songs.

মত্ত করিবর যেন গমন মন্থর ।
হরি হরি ধ্বনি শুনি' অবশ অন্তর ॥ ৭ ॥

matta karibara yena gamana manthara |
hari hari dhbani śuni' abaśa antara || 7 ||

matta karivara yena — like a maddened elephant; gamana manthara — His gait is slow; hari hari dhvani shuni — hearing the cry "Hari, Hari!"; avasha antara — His heart is helpless

7His gait is slow, like a maddened elephant's;
hearing the cry "Hari, Hari!", He is not master of Himself.

পথ আগুলিয়া চলে অঙ্গ হেলাইয়া ।
পদ দুই গিয়া রহে চৌদিগে চাহিয়া ॥ ৮ ॥

patha āguliẏā cale aṅga helāiẏā |
pada dui giẏā rahe caudige cāhiẏā || 8 ||

patha aguliya — blocking the road; chale anga helaiya — He walks swaying His body; pada dui giya — after two steps; rahe chaudige chahiya — stops, looking all around

8Swaying, He walks, blocking the road;
after two steps He stops and looks all around.

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ।
কদম্ব-কেশর জিনি' একটি পুলক ॥ ৯ ॥

pulakita saba aṅga āpāda-mastaka |
kadamba-keśara jini' ekaṭi pulaka || 9 ||

pulakita saba anga — His whole body thrilled; apada-mastaka — from feet to head; kadamba-keshara jini — surpassing kadamba filaments; ekati pulaka — each single thrill

9His whole body thrills from feet to head:
each hair standing on end surpasses the kadamba's filaments.

বক্র-গ্রীবায় দু-ভিত নেহালে রাঙ্গা আঁখি ।
ক্ষণে উনমাদে ধায় উচ্চনাদে ডাকি' ॥ ১০ ॥

bakra-grībāẏa du-bhita nehāle rāṅgā āṁkhi |
kṣaṇe unamāde dhāẏa uccanāde ḍāki' || 10 ||

vakra-grivaya — with bent neck; du-bhita nehale — looks to both sides; ranga ankhi — with red eyes; kshane unamade dhaya — at times runs in rapture; uchchanade daki — calling loudly

10With bent neck He looks to both sides with red eyes;
at times He runs in rapture, calling loudly.

এইমত শত শত লোক পাছে ধায় ।
আনন্দে বিভোর গেলা যথা গোরারায় ॥ ১১ ॥

eimata śata śata loka pāche dhāẏa |
ānande bibhora gelā yathā gorārāẏa || 11 ||

eimata — thus; shata shata loka — hundreds of people; pachhe dhaya — run behind; anande vibhora — absorbed in bliss; gela yatha goraraya — He went to where Gora-raya was

11So, with hundreds of people running behind Him,
absorbed in bliss He came to where Gora-raya was.

নিত্যানন্দ দেখি' প্রভু গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর ।
দুঁহু আলিঙ্গন করে প্রেমে গরগর ॥ ১২ ॥

nityānanda dekhi' prabhu gaurāṅgasundara |
duṁhu āliṅgana kare preme garagara || 12 ||

nityananda dekhi — seeing Nityananda; prabhu gauranga-sundara — the Lord Gaurasundara; dunhu alingana kare — the two embrace; preme garagara — overflowing with prema

12Seeing Nityananda, the Lord Gaurasundara [embraces Him]:
the two embrace, overflowing with prema.

দোঁহার নয়নে ঝরে প্রেমানন্দ-নীর ।
আনন্দে বিভোর দোঁহে অথির-শরীর ॥ ১৩ ॥

doṁhāra naẏane jhare premānanda-nīra |
ānande bibhora doṁhe athira-śarīra || 13 ||

donhara nayane — from the eyes of both; jhare premananda-nira — tears of prema's bliss flow; anande vibhora donhe — both absorbed in bliss; athira-sharira — their bodies unsteady

13Tears of prema's bliss flow from the eyes of both;
both are absorbed in bliss, Their bodies unsteady.

আনন্দে নাচয়ে দুঁহে সঙ্গে নিজজন ।
কৃষ্ণ-বলরাম-সঙ্গে যেন শিশুগণ ॥ ১৪ ॥

ānande nācaẏe duṁhe saṅge nijajana |
kṛṣṇa-balarāma-saṅge yena śiśugaṇa || 14 ||

anande nachaye dunhe — both dance joyfully; sange nijajana — with Them Their own; krishna-balarama-sange — with Krishna and Balarama; yena shishugana — like the [cowherd] boys

14Both dance in joy, and with Them Their own,
like the cowherd boys with Krishna and Balarama.

নৃত্য-অবসানে প্রভু কহিল সভারে ।
নিত্যানন্দ-পাদ-প্রক্ষালন করিবারে ॥ ১৫ ॥

nṛtya-abasāne prabhu kahila sabhāre |
nityānanda-pāda-prakṣālana karibāre || 15 ||

nritya-avasane — at the end of the dance; prabhu kahila sabhare — the Lord told all; nityananda-pada-prakshalana — the washing of Nityananda's feet; karibare — to perform

15When the dance ended, the Lord told everyone
to wash Nityananda's feet:

নিত্যানন্দ-পাদোদক লহ শিরোপরি ।
পাইবে পরম প্রেমা আনন্দ-লহরী ॥ ১৬ ॥

nityānanda-pādodaka laha śiropari |
pāibe parama premā ānanda-laharī || 16 ||

nityananda-padodaka — the water of Nityananda's feet; laha shiropari — place on your heads; paibe parama prema — you will attain supreme prema; ananda-lahari — waves of bliss

16"Place on your heads the water of Nityananda's feet —
you will attain supreme prema, waves of bliss."

হেনমতে মহাপ্রভু আজ্ঞা যবে কৈল ।
শুনিঞা সভার হিয়া আনন্দ বাঢ়িল ॥ ১৭ ॥

henamate mahāprabhu ājñā yabe kaila |
śuniñā sabhāra hiẏā ānanda bāṛhila || 17 ||

henamate — thus; mahaprabhu ajna yabe kaila — when Mahaprabhu commanded; shuninya — hearing; sabhara hiya — in all hearts; ananda badhila — joy grew

17When Mahaprabhu gave this command,
the joy in the hearts of all who heard it grew.

একে চাহে আরে পায় প্রভু-আজ্ঞাবাণী ।
মস্তকে ধরিল পাদ-প্রক্ষালন-পানী ॥ ১৮ ॥

eke cāhe āre pāẏa prabhu-ājñābāṇī |
mastake dharila pāda-prakṣālana-pānī || 18 ||

eke chahe are paya — seeking one thing, they found more; prabhu-ajna-vani — the Lord's command; mastake dharila — placed on their heads; pada-prakshalana-pani — the water that washed the feet

18They longed for one thing and received more — the Lord's command;
they placed on their heads the water that had washed [His] feet.

তবে অবধূত প্রভু প্রভু-আজ্ঞা শুনি' ।
রক্তিম-নয়ানে ছলছল করে পানী ॥ ১৯ ॥

tabe abadhūta prabhu prabhu-ājñā śuni' |
raktima-naẏāne chalachala kare pānī || 19 ||

tabe — then; avadhuta prabhu — Avadhuta Prabhu; prabhu-ajna shuni — hearing the Lord's command; raktima-nayane — in His reddened eyes; chhalachhala kare pani — tears brimmed

19Then Avadhuta Prabhu, hearing the Lord's command —
tears brimmed in His reddened eyes.

উঠিয়া আনন্দে সর্বজন করি' কোলে ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু আনন্দ-হিল্লোলে ॥ ২০ ॥

uṭhiẏā ānande sarbajana kari' kole |
uthalila premasindhu ānanda-hillole || 20 ||

uthiya — rising; anande sarvajana kari kole — joyfully embracing everyone; uthalila premasindhu — the ocean of prema surged; ananda-hillole — in waves of bliss

20Rising, He joyfully embraces everyone:
the ocean of prema surged in waves of bliss.

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল সভে করয়ে ক্রন্দন ।
হৃদয়ে ধরয়ে অবধূতের চরণ ॥ ২১ ॥

premāẏa bihbala sabhe karaẏe krandana |
hṛdaẏe dharaẏe abadhūtera caraṇa || 21 ||

premaya vihvala — overwhelmed by prema; sabhe karaye krandana — all weep; hridaye dharaye — clasp to their hearts; avadhutera charana — the Avadhuta's feet

21Overwhelmed by prema, all weep
and clasp the Avadhuta's feet to their hearts.

প্রেম-মহামহোৎসব বাঢ়িল অপার ।
অন্তরে ঝলমল করে বাহ্যেতে বিকার ॥ ২২ ॥

prema-mahāmahotsaba bāṛhila apāra |
antare jhalamala kare bāhyete bikāra || 22 ||

prema-mahamahotsava — the great festival of prema; badhila apara — grew boundlessly; antare jhalamala kare — within it shines; bahyete vikara — outwardly, transformations [of ecstasy]

22The great festival of prema grew boundlessly:
within — radiance, without — the transformations of ecstasy.

ঐছন দেখিয়া প্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
অন্তর-সন্তোষে চাহে প্রসন্ন-বয়ান ॥ ২৩ ॥

aichana dekhiẏā prabhu gaura bhagabān |
antara-santoṣe cāhe prasanna-baẏāna || 23 ||

aichhana dekhiya — seeing this; prabhu gaura bhagavan — the Lord Gaura Bhagavan; antara-santoshe — with inner satisfaction; chahe prasanna-bayana — gazes with serene face

23Seeing this, the Lord Gaura Bhagavan
looks on with a serene face, rejoicing at heart.3

সর্বজন স্তব করে বেঢ়ি' চারিপাশে ।
হেনকালে আচম্বিতে আইলা হরিদাসে ॥ ২৪ ॥

sarbajana staba kare beṛhi' cāripāśe |
henakāle ācambite āilā haridāse || 24 ||

sarvajana stava kare — all offer praise; bedhi charipashe — surrounding [Him] on all sides; henakale achambite — at that time suddenly; aila haridase — Haridasa came

24All, surrounding [Him] on every side, offer praise;
at that time Haridasa suddenly came:

শুদ্ধ স্ফটিকের মালা ধরিয়া গলায় ।
হেমমণি-মুখর মঞ্জীর রাঙ্গা পায় ॥ ২৫ ॥

śuddha sphaṭikera mālā dhariẏā galāẏa |
hemamaṇi-mukhara mañjīra rāṅgā pāẏa || 25 ||

shuddha sphatikera mala — a necklace of pure crystal; dhariya galaya — wearing on his neck; hemamani-mukhara manjira — tinkling golden anklets; ranga paya — on his red feet

25on his neck a necklace of pure crystal,
golden bells tinkling on his red feet;

পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ সজল-নয়ন ।
প্রেমে টলমল তনু হুঙ্কার-গর্জন ॥ ২৬ ॥

pulakita saba aṅga sajala-naẏana |
preme ṭalamala tanu huṅkāra-garjana || 26 ||

pulakita saba anga — his whole body thrilled; sajala-nayana — eyes full of tears; preme talamala tanu — his body swaying with prema; hunkara-garjana — roars of "hum!" and thundering

26his whole body thrilled, his eyes full of tears,
his body swaying with prema, he roars "hum!" and calls aloud.

নির্ভর-প্রেমায় নাচে প্রভুর সম্মুখে ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে তার প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ॥ ২৭ ॥

nirbhara-premāẏa nāce prabhura sammukhe |
brahmāṇḍe nā dhare tāra premānanda-sukhe || 27 ||

nirbhara-premaya — in the fullness of prema; nache prabhura sammukhe — he dances before the Lord; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot contain; tara premananda-sukhe — his happiness in prema's bliss

27In the fullness of prema he dances before the Lord —
the universe cannot contain his happiness in prema's bliss.

পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য আচমনীয় গৃহ-ব্যবহারে ।
আদেশিল আপনে ভোজন করিবারে ॥ ২৮ ॥

pādya arghya ācamanīẏa gṛha-byabahāre |
ādeśila āpane bhojana karibāre || 28 ||

padya arghya achamaniya — water for the feet, arghya, water for sipping; griha-vyavahare — by the custom of hospitality; adeshila apane — He Himself bade; bhojana karibare — to take food

28[The Lord], by the custom of hospitality [offering] water for the feet, arghya and water for sipping, Himself bade [him] take food.4

হেনকালে অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আচম্বিত ।
প্রভুর নিকটে আসি' হৈল উপনীত ॥ ২৯ ॥

henakāle adbaita-ācārya ācambita |
prabhura nikaṭe āsi' haila upanīta || 29 ||

henakale — at that time; advaita-acharya achambita — suddenly Advaita Acharya; prabhura nikate asi — coming near the Lord; haila upanita — arrived

29At that time Advaita Acharya suddenly
came to the Lord.

ঠাকুর উঠিয়া কৈল বন্দন তাঁহার ।
সর্বজন উঠিয়া করিল নমস্কার ॥ ৩০ ॥

ṭhākura uṭhiẏā kaila bandana tāṁhāra |
sarbajana uṭhiẏā karila namaskāra || 30 ||

thakura uthiya — the Thakura, rising; kaila bandana tanhara — honoured Him; sarvajana uthiya — all, rising; karila namaskara — bowed

30The Thakura rose and honoured Him,
and all, rising, bowed to Him.

নাচিতে নাচিতে ব্রহ্মা মূর্তিমান্ হঞা ।
দণ্ডবৎ করে প্রভুর চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ৩১ ॥

nācite nācite brahmā mūrtimān hañā |
daṇḍabat kare prabhura caraṇe paṛiẏā || 31 ||

nachite nachite — dancing and dancing; brahma murtiman hanya — Brahma becoming manifest; dandavat kare — prostrates; prabhura charane padiya — falling at the Lord's feet

31Dancing and dancing, [Haridasa], in whom Brahma manifested,
falls at the Lord's feet and prostrates;

চতুর্মুখে স্তব করে বেদ উচ্চারিয়া ।
শান্ত হও বলি' প্রভু তোলে কোলে লঞা ॥ ৩২ ॥

caturmukhe staba kare beda uccāriẏā |
śānta hao bali' prabhu tole kole lañā || 32 ||

chaturmukhe — with four mouths; stava kare — offers praise; veda uchchariya — reciting the Vedas; shanta hao bali — saying "Be calm!"; prabhu tole kole lanya — the Lord lifts him into His arms

32with four mouths, reciting the Vedas, he offers praise.
"Be calm!" says the Lord, lifts him up and embraces him.

শান্ত হঞা হরিদাস নাচে কান্দে হাসে ।
দিগ্বিদিগ্ নাহি প্রেমানন্দে ভাসে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

śānta hañā haridāsa nāce kānde hāse |
digbidig nāhi premānande bhāse || 33 ||

shanta hanya — becoming calm; haridasa nache kande hase — Haridasa dances, weeps, laughs; digvidig nahi — knowing no directions; premanande bhase — floats in prema's bliss

33Becoming calm, Haridasa dances, weeps and laughs,
knowing no directions, floating in prema's bliss.5

সম্ভ্রম পাইল তবে আচার্য-গোসাঞি ।
আজ্ঞা শিরে করি' অন্ন ভুঞ্জিলা তথাই ॥ ৩৪ ॥

sambhrama pāila tabe ācārya-gosāñi |
ājñā śire kari' anna bhuñjilā tathāi || 34 ||

sambhrama paila — was filled with reverent awe; tabe acharya-gosanyi — then Acharya Gosani; ajna shire kari — taking the command on his head; anna bhunjila tathai — ate there

34Then Acharya Gosani was filled with reverent awe
and, taking the command on his head, ate there.

হেনমতে সব নিজজন-সঙ্গে পহুঁ ।
নিভৃতে বসিয়া ঘরে হাসে লহু লহু ॥ ৩৫ ॥

henamate saba nijajana-saṅge pahuṁ |
nibhṛte basiẏā ghare hāse lahu lahu || 35 ||

henamate — thus; saba nijajana-sange — with all His own; pahu — the Lord; nibhrite basiya ghare — sitting secluded in the house; hase lahu lahu — smiles gently

35So the Lord with all His own
sits secluded in the house, smiling gently.

নিজজন-সঙ্গে পহুঁ নিজকথা কহে ।
যে কারণে কৈল প্রভু পৃথিবী-বিজয়ে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

nijajana-saṅge pahuṁ nijakathā kahe |
ye kāraṇe kaila prabhu pṛthibī-bijaẏe || 36 ||

nijajana-sange — with His own; pahu nija-katha kahe — the Lord speaks of Himself; ye karane — for what reason; kaila prabhu prithivi-vijaye — the Lord came to the earth

36Among His own the Lord speaks of Himself —
of the reasons for which He came to the earth:

নিজ-ভাব-আস্বাদন অধর্ম-বিনাশ ।
ধর্ম-সংস্থাপন নাম-কীর্তন-প্রকাশ ॥ ৩৭ ॥

nija-bhāba-āsbādana adharma-bināśa |
dharma-saṃsthāpana nāma-kīrtana-prakāśa || 37 ||

nija-bhava-asvadana — tasting His own bhava; adharma-vinasha — destruction of irreligion; dharma-samsthapana — establishment of dharma; nama-kirtana-prakasha — manifestation of the kirtana of the name

37"To taste My own bhava, to destroy irreligion,
to establish dharma and to reveal the kirtana of the name.

দেশে দেশে প্রকাশ করিব ঘরে ঘরে ।
ব্রজভাব দাস্য-সখ্য-বাৎসল্য-শৃঙ্গারে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

deśe deśe prakāśa kariba ghare ghare |
brajabhāba dāsya-sakhya-bātsalya-śṛṅgāre || 38 ||

deshe deshe — in every land; prakasha kariba ghare ghare — I will reveal in every home; vraja-bhava — the bhava of Vraja; dasya-sakhya-vatsalya-shringare — in servitude, friendship, parental love and amorous love

38In every land, in every home, I will reveal
the bhava of Vraja — servitude, friendship, parental love and amorous love.

ভুঞ্জাব অধিক রাধাকৃষ্ণ-প্রেমধন ।
আপনি ভুঞ্জিমু ভুঞ্জাইমু ত্রিভুবন ॥ ৩৯ ॥

bhuñjāba adhika rādhākṛṣṇa-premadhana |
āpani bhuñjimu bhuñjāimu tribhubana || 39 ||

bhunjaba adhika — I will give to taste above all; radhakrishna-premadhana — the treasure of prema for Radha and Krishna; apani bhunjimu — I Myself will taste; bhunjaimu tribhuvana — I will make the three worlds taste

39Above all I will give to taste the treasure of prema for Radha and Krishna:
I Myself will taste it and make the three worlds taste it.

সুরাসুরগণে দিমু এই প্রেমধন ।
চণ্ডাল যবন মূর্খ স্ত্রী বালক জন ॥ ৪০ ॥

surāsuragaṇe dimu ei premadhana |
caṇḍāla yabana mūrkha strī bālaka jana || 40 ||

surasura-gane — to gods and asuras; dimu ei premadhana — I will give this treasure of prema; chandala yavana murkha — to chandalas, yavanas, the ignorant; stri balaka jana — to women and children

40To gods and asuras I will give this treasure of prema,
to chandalas, yavanas, the ignorant, women and children.

বৃন্দাবন-সুখ আমি নদীয়া আনিঞা ।
দেশে দেশে ভুঞ্জাইব তো-সভারে লঞা ॥ ৪১ ॥

bṛndābana-sukha āmi nadīẏā āniñā |
deśe deśe bhuñjāiba to-sabhāre lañā || 41 ||

vrindavana-sukha — the happiness of Vrindavana; ami nadiya aninya — I, bringing to Nadia; deshe deshe bhunjaiba — will give to taste in every land; to-sabhare lanya — together with all of you

41Bringing the happiness of Vrindavana to Nadia,
together with all of you I will give it to taste in every land."6

অতি অপরূপ কথা নদীয়া-বিহার ।
একত্র এ সব কথা করিব প্রচার ॥ ৪২ ॥

ati aparūpa kathā nadīẏā-bihāra |
ekatra e saba kathā kariba pracāra || 42 ||

ati aparupa katha — a most wondrous story; nadiya-vihara — the pastimes in Nadia; ekatra — together; e saba katha — all these stories; kariba prachara — I shall proclaim

42A most wondrous story — the pastimes in Nadia;
all these stories I shall proclaim together.

গদাধর নরহরি বৈসে দুইপাশে ।
শ্রীরঘুনন্দন পদ-নিকটে বিলাসে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

gadādhara narahari baise duipāśe |
śrīraghunandana pada-nikaṭe bilāse || 43 ||

gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara and Narahari; baise duipashe — sit on both sides; shri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; pada-nikate vilase — delights near [His] feet

43Gadadhara and Narahari sit on both sides,
Sri Raghunandana delights near His feet;

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আর নিত্যানন্দরায় ।
আপনে ঠাকুর নিজগুণগাথা গায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

adbaita-ācārya āra nityānandarāẏa |
āpane ṭhākura nijaguṇagāthā gāẏa || 44 ||

advaita-acharya ara nityananda-raya — Advaita Acharya and Nityananda-raya; apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; nija-guna-gatha gaya — sings the song of His own qualities

44Advaita Acharya and Nityananda-raya —
and the Thakura Himself sings the song of His own qualities;

মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত আর শ্রীনিবাস ।
হরিদাস-আদি যত প্রেমার আবাস ॥ ৪৫ ॥

murāri mukundadatta āra śrīnibāsa |
haridāsa-ādi yata premāra ābāsa || 45 ||

murari mukunda-datta ara shrinivasa — Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa; haridasa-adi — Haridasa and others; yata premara avasa — all abodes of prema

45Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa,
Haridasa and the rest — all abodes of prema;

শুক্লাম্বর বক্রেশ্বর শ্রীমান্ সঞ্জয় ।
শ্রীধর-পণ্ডিত-আদি যত মহাশয় ॥ ৪৬ ॥

śuklāmbara bakreśbara śrīmān sañjaẏa |
śrīdhara-paṇḍita-ādi yata mahāśaẏa || 46 ||

shuklambara vakreshvara shriman sanjaya — Shuklambara, Vakreshvara, Shriman, Sanjaya; shridhara-pandita-adi — Shridhara Pandita and others; yata mahashaya — all the great souls

46Shuklambara, Vakreshvara, Shriman, Sanjaya,
Shridhara Pandita and the other great souls.7

একজন মহিমা কহিতে জানে কেবা ।
আপনি অবনী অবতরে গৌরদেবা ॥ ৪৭ ॥

ekajana mahimā kahite jāne kebā |
āpani abanī abatare gauradebā || 47 ||

ekajana mahima — the glory of even one; kahite jane keba — who knows how to tell; apani avani — Himself to the earth; avatare gauradeva — Gauradeva descends

47Who can tell the glory of even one of them?
Gauradeva Himself has descended to the earth!

উপমা দিবারে নাহি নদীয়া-প্রকাশ ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৮ ॥

upamā dibāre nāhi nadīẏā-prakāśa |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 48 ||

upama dibare nahi — there is no comparison for; nadiya-prakasha — the manifestation in Nadia; ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

48The manifestation in Nadia has no comparison —
so says with a joyful heart this Lochana Dasa.

Raga gurjari; disha: "Gorachand is my life!" (with vocables); refrain: "Hari, Rama, Narayana — golden Gora, Shachi's darling!"

কহিব অপূর্ব কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
শুনিলে সকল পাপ হয় বিমোচন ॥ ৪৯ ॥

kahiba apūrba kathā śuna sarbajana |
śunile sakala pāpa haẏa bimocana || 49 ||

kahiba apurva katha — I shall tell an unprecedented story; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; shunile — on hearing it; sakala papa haya vimochana — all sins are removed

49I shall tell an unprecedented story — hear, all:
whoever hears it is freed from all sins.

নবদ্বীপে গৌরচন্দ্র আপন আবাসে ।
শিষ্যগণ-সঙ্গে আছে বিনোদ-বিলাসে ॥ ৫০ ॥

nabadbīpe gauracandra āpana ābāse |
śiṣyagaṇa-saṅge āche binoda-bilāse || 50 ||

navadvipe — in Navadvipa; gaurachandra apana avase — Gaurachandra in His own home; shishyagana-sange — with His disciples; achhe vinoda-vilase — is in joyful play

50In Navadvipa, in His own home,
Gaurachandra is in joyful play with His disciples.

নিজভক্তগণ সব করি' এক মেলি ।
নিজগুণ-সংকীর্তনে প্রেমানন্দে ভুলি' ॥ ৫১ ॥

nijabhaktagaṇa saba kari' eka meli |
nijaguṇa-saṃkīrtane premānande bhuli' || 51 ||

nija-bhaktagana saba — all His devotees; kari eka meli — gathering together; nija-guna-sankirtane — in the sankirtana of His own qualities; premanande bhuli — lost in prema's bliss

51Gathering all His devotees together,
He was lost in prema's bliss in the sankirtana of His own qualities.

হাসিয়া কহিল প্রভু ভক্ত সভাকারে ।
এই মোর হরিনাম দেহ ঘরে ঘরে ॥ ৫২ ॥

hāsiẏā kahila prabhu bhakta sabhākāre |
ei mora harināma deha ghare ghare || 52 ||

hasiya kahila prabhu — laughing, the Lord said; bhakta sabhakare — to all the devotees; ei mora harinama — this name of Hari of Mine; deha ghare ghare — give in every home

52Laughing, the Lord said to all the devotees:
"Give this name of Hari of Mine in every home.

নবদ্বীপে বাল বৃদ্ধ বৈসে যত জন ।
চণ্ডাল দুর্গত আর সজ্জন দুর্জন ॥ ৫৩ ॥

nabadbīpe bāla bṛddha baise yata jana |
caṇḍāla durgata āra sajjana durjana || 53 ||

navadvipe — in Navadvipa; bala vriddha — children and old people; baise yata jana — all who live; chandala durgata — chandalas, the wretched; ara sajjana durjana — and the good and the wicked

53All who live in Navadvipa — children and old people,
chandalas and the wretched, the good and the wicked —

সভারে শিখাও হরিনাম গ্রন্থি করি' ।
অনায়াসে সর্বলোক যাউ ভব তরি' ॥ ৫৪ ॥

sabhāre śikhāo harināma granthi kari' |
anāẏāse sarbaloka yāu bhaba tari' || 54 ||

sabhare shikhao — teach everyone; harinama granthi kari — the name of Hari, tying [it] in a knot; anayase sarvaloka — let all people easily; yau bhava tari — cross the ocean of existence

54teach them all the name of Hari, tying it fast,
so that all people may easily cross the ocean of existence."8

শুনিঞা সকল ভক্ত কহিল প্রভুরে ।
না পারিব হরিনাম দিতে ঘরে ঘরে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

śuniñā sakala bhakta kahila prabhure |
nā pāriba harināma dite ghare ghare || 55 ||

shuninya — hearing; sakala bhakta kahila prabhure — all the devotees said to the Lord; na pariba — we cannot; harinama dite ghare ghare — give the name of Hari in every home

55Hearing this, all the devotees said to the Lord:
"We cannot give the name of Hari in every home.

সেই নবদ্বীপে এক আছয়ে দুরন্ত ।
অতি দুরাচার সেই পাপে নাহি অন্ত ॥ ৫৬ ॥

sei nabadbīpe eka āchaẏe duranta |
ati durācāra sei pāpe nāhi anta || 56 ||

sei navadvipe — in that Navadvipa; eka achhaye duranta — there is one calamity; ati durachara sei — most wicked; pape nahi anta — their sins have no end

56In this Navadvipa there is one calamity:
most wicked [men], whose sins have no end —

মহাপাপী ব্রাহ্মণ সে আছে দুই ভাই ।
নবদ্বীপের ঠাকুর সে জগাই মাধাই ॥ ৫৭ ॥

mahāpāpī brāhmaṇa se āche dui bhāi |
nabadbīpera ṭhākura se jagāi mādhāi || 57 ||

mahapapi brahmana — greatly sinful brahmanas; se achhe dui bhai — there are two brothers; navadvipera thakura — the masters of Navadvipa; se jagai madhai — they are Jagai and Madhai

57two brothers, greatly sinful brahmanas,
the masters of Navadvipa, Jagai and Madhai.9

ব্রাহ্মণী যবনী গুর্বঙ্গনা নাহি এড়ে ।
সুরাপান পাইলে সকল কর্ম ছাড়ে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

brāhmaṇī yabanī gurbaṅganā nāhi eṛe |
surāpāna pāile sakala karma chāṛe || 58 ||

brahmani yavani gurvangana — brahmana women, yavana women, the guru's wife; nahi ede — they spare none; surapana paile — getting liquor; sakala karma chhade — they abandon all duties

58They spare neither brahmana women, nor Muslim women, nor the wives of gurus;
getting liquor, they abandon all duties.

দেব-গুরু-ব্রাহ্মণের হিংসা নিরন্তর ।
বাহির হইলে বিনা বধে না যায় ঘর ॥ ৫৯ ॥

deba-guru-brāhmaṇera hiṃsā nirantara |
bāhira haile binā badhe nā yāẏa ghara || 59 ||

deva-guru-brahmanera — to gods, gurus and brahmanas; himsa nirantara — constant violence; bahira haile — when they go out; vina vadhe na yaya ghara — they do not return home without a killing

59They constantly do violence to gods, gurus and brahmanas;
when they go out, they do not return home without a killing.

ব্রহ্মবধ গোবধ স্ত্রীবধ শত শত ।
লিখিতে না পারি পাপ করিয়াছে কত ॥ ৬০ ॥

brahmabadha gobadha strībadha śata śata |
likhite nā pāri pāpa kariẏāche kata || 60 ||

brahma-vadha go-vadha stri-vadha — killing of brahmanas, cows, women; shata shata — by hundreds; likhite na pari — I cannot write; papa kariyachhe kata — how many sins they have committed

60Killings of brahmanas, cows, women — by hundreds;
I cannot write how many sins they have committed.

গঙ্গাকূলে বৈসে গঙ্গাস্নান নাহি করে ।
দেবতা পূজয়ে নাহি আজন্ম-ভিতরে ॥ ৬১ ॥

gaṅgākūle baise gaṅgāsnāna nāhi kare |
debatā pūjaẏe nāhi ājanma-bhitare || 61 ||

ganga-kule baise — they live on the bank of the Ganga; gangasnana nahi kare — do not bathe in the Ganga; devata pujaye nahi — do not worship the gods; ajanma-bhitare — in all their lives

61They live on the bank of the Ganga, yet do not bathe in the Ganga;
never in their lives have they worshipped the gods.

নিরন্তর স্বজন-বান্ধবে করে দণ্ড ।
কৃষ্ণগুণ-সংকীর্তনে পরম পাষণ্ড ॥ ৬২ ॥

nirantara sbajana-bāndhabe kare daṇḍa |
kṛṣṇaguṇa-saṃkīrtane parama pāṣaṇḍa || 62 ||

nirantara — constantly; svajana-bandhave kare danda — they punish their own kin and friends; krishna-guna-sankirtane — towards the sankirtana of Krishna's qualities; parama pashanda — utter atheists

62They constantly punish their own kin and friends;
towards the sankirtana of Krishna's qualities they are utter atheists.

সহস্র কায়স্থ যদি শত জন্ম লেখে ।
তথাপি তাহার পাপ অন্ত নাহি দেখে ॥ ৬২+১ ॥

sahasra kāẏastha yadi śata janma lekhe |
tathāpi tāhāra pāpa anta nāhi dekhe || 62+1 ||

sahasra kayastha — a thousand scribes; yadi shata janma lekhe — if they write for a hundred births; tathapi — even then; tahara papa anta nahi dekhe — they would not see the end of their sins

62+1Even if a thousand scribes were to write [them] down for a hundred births,
they would still not see the end of their sins"10.

একদিন আছে প্রভু নিজজন-মেলে ।
কথার প্রসঙ্গে তার কথা হেনকালে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

ekadina āche prabhu nijajana-mele |
kathāra prasaṅge tāra kathā henakāle || 63 ||

ekadina achhe prabhu — one day the Lord was; nijajana-mele — among His own; kathara prasange — in the course of conversation; tara katha henakale — then talk of them [arose]

63One day, when the Lord was among His own,
in the course of conversation talk of them arose.

কহিল সকল লোক প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে ।
শুনিঞা রুষিলা প্রভু গুণে মনে মনে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

kahila sakala loka prabhu-bidyamāne |
śuniñā ruṣilā prabhu guṇe mane mane || 64 ||

kahila sakala loka — everyone told; prabhu-vidyamane — before the Lord; shuninya rushila prabhu — hearing, the Lord grew angry; gune mane mane — pondering within

64Everyone told [of them] before the Lord;
hearing it, the Lord grew angry, pondering within.

অরুণ বরণ ভেল রাঙ্গা দুই আঁখি ।
যে কহিলে তোমরা অন্তরে পাই সাক্ষী ॥ ৬৫ ॥

aruṇa baraṇa bhela rāṅgā dui āṁkhi |
ye kahile tomarā antare pāi sākṣī || 65 ||

aruna varana bhela — His colour turned red; ranga dui ankhi — both eyes red; ye kahile tomara — what you have said; antare pai sakshi — I find witness to it within

65His face turned red, both eyes reddened:
"What you have said, My heart too bears witness to.

অজামিল-নামে পাপী আছিল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
মরিবার বেলে নাম লৈল নারায়ণ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

ajāmila-nāme pāpī āchila brāhmaṇa |
maribāra bele nāma laila nārāẏaṇa || 66 ||

ajamila-name — named Ajamila; papi achhila brahmana — there was a sinful brahmana; maribara bele — at the time of death; nama laila narayana — he uttered the name "Narayana"

66There was a sinful brahmana named Ajamila;
at the hour of death he uttered the name "Narayana".

পুত্রস্নেহে নারায়ণ নাম লৈল সেহ ।
বৈকুণ্ঠ পাইল দ্বিজ পাঞা দিব্যদেহ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

putrasnehe nārāẏaṇa nāma laila seha |
baikuṇṭha pāila dbija pāñā dibyadeha || 67 ||

putra-snehe — out of love for his son; narayana nama laila seha — he uttered the name "Narayana"; vaikuntha paila dvija — the brahmana attained Vaikuntha; panya divya-deha — receiving a divine body

67Out of love for his son he uttered the name "Narayana" —
and the brahmana, receiving a divine body, attained Vaikuntha.11

তাহার অধিক পাপী জগাই মাধাই ।
উহার নিস্তার হবে কেমন উপায় ॥ ৬৮ ॥

tāhāra adhika pāpī jagāi mādhāi |
uhāra nistāra habe kemana upāẏa || 68 ||

tahara adhika papi — more sinful than he; jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai; uhara nistara habe — their deliverance will be; kemana upaya — by what means

68Jagai and Madhai are more sinful than he:
by what means will they be delivered?

তাহার লাগিয়া মোর অন্তর কাতর ।
যে কিছু কহিয়ে সভে শুনহ উত্তর ॥ ৬৯ ॥

tāhāra lāgiẏā mora antara kātara |
ye kichu kahiẏe sabhe śunaha uttara || 69 ||

tahara lagiya — for their sake; mora antara katara — My heart is pained; ye kichhu kahiye — whatever I say; sabhe shunaha uttara — all hear the answer

69For their sake My heart is pained;
all of you, hear what I say in answer.

হরিনাম-সংকীর্তন কলিযুগ-ধর্ম ।
নামগুণ-সংকীর্তনে সাধিব সব কর্ম ॥ ৭০ ॥

harināma-saṃkīrtana kaliyuga-dharma |
nāmaguṇa-saṃkīrtane sādhiba saba karma || 70 ||

harinama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name; kaliyuga-dharma — is the dharma of the age of Kali; nama-guna-sankirtane — by the sankirtana of the name and qualities; sadhiba saba karma — I will accomplish the whole task

70The sankirtana of Hari's name is the dharma of the age of Kali:
by the sankirtana of the name and qualities I will accomplish the whole task.

আনহ যেখানে যেই আছে বন্ধুজন ।
মিলিয়া সকল লোক কর সংকীর্তন ॥ ৭১ ॥

ānaha yekhāne yei āche bandhujana |
miliẏā sakala loka kara saṃkīrtana || 71 ||

anaha — bring; yekhane yei achhe — wherever any are; bandhujana — friends; miliya sakala loka — gathering, all people; kara sankirtana — perform sankirtana

71Bring your friends, wherever they may be;
gathering all together, perform sankirtana.

গায়ন বায়ন লঞা মৃদঙ্গ করতাল ।
উচ্চস্বরে কর নাম-কীর্তন রসাল ॥ ৭২ ॥

gāẏana bāẏana lañā mṛdaṅga karatāla |
uccasbare kara nāma-kīrtana rasāla || 72 ||

gayana vayana lanya — taking singers and players; mridanga karatala — mridangas and karatalas; uchchasvare — with loud voices; kara nama-kirtana rasala — perform sweet kirtana of the name

72Taking singers and players, mridangas and karatalas,
sing aloud the sweet kirtana of the name.

নগরে বেঢ়াব আমি কীর্তন করিয়া ।
আইল সকল লোক এ বোল শুনিঞা ॥ ৭৩ ॥

nagare beṛhāba āmi kīrtana kariẏā |
āila sakala loka e bola śuniñā || 73 ||

nagare bedhaba ami — I will go round the town; kirtana kariya — performing kirtana; aila sakala loka — all came; e bola shuninya — hearing these words

73I will go round the town performing kirtana."
Hearing these words, all came:

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য আর তাঁর নিজজন ।
অবধূত নিত্যানন্দ প্রসন্ন-বদন ॥ ৭৪ ॥

adbaita-ācārya āra tāṁra nijajana |
abadhūta nityānanda prasanna-badana || 74 ||

advaita-acharya ara tanra nijajana — Advaita Acharya and His people; avadhuta nityananda — the Avadhuta Nityananda; prasanna-vadana — with a serene face

74Advaita Acharya and His people,
the Avadhuta Nityananda with a serene face,

হরিদাস শ্রীনিবাস মিলি' চারি ভাই ।
মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত পণ্ডিত গদাই ॥ ৭৫ ॥

haridāsa śrīnibāsa mili' cāri bhāi |
murāri mukundadatta paṇḍita gadāi || 75 ||

haridasa — Haridasa; shrinivasa mili chari bhai — Srinivasa with his four brothers; murari mukunda-datta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; pandita gadai — Pandita Gadai (Gadadhara)

75Haridasa, Srinivasa with his four brothers,
Murari, Mukunda Datta, Pandita Gadai,

শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্য আর শুক্লাম্বর ।
সর্বজন মিলি' আইলা ঠাকুরের ঘর ॥ ৭৬ ॥

śrīcandraśekharācārya āra śuklāmbara |
sarbajana mili' āilā ṭhākurera ghara || 76 ||

shri-chandrashekhara-acharya — Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya; ara shuklambara — and Shuklambara; sarvajana mili — all together; aila thakurera ghara — came to the Thakura's house

76Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya and Shuklambara —
all together came to the Thakura's house.

যেখানে আছিল ভক্তগণ যত যত ।
প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় সভে হৈ গেল একত্র ॥ ৭৭ ॥

yekhāne āchila bhaktagaṇa yata yata |
prabhura ājñāẏa sabhe hai gela ekatra || 77 ||

yekhane achhila — wherever they were; bhaktagana yata yata — all the devotees; prabhura ajnaya — at the Lord's command; sabhe hai gela ekatra — all came together

77All the devotees, wherever they were,
at the Lord's command gathered together.

একত্র হইয়া সভে সংকীর্তন করি' ।
বিজয় করিলা প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর হরি ॥ ৭৮ ॥

ekatra haiẏā sabhe saṃkīrtana kari' |
bijaẏa karilā prabhu biśbambhara hari || 78 ||

ekatra haiya sabhe — all gathering together; sankirtana kari — performing sankirtana; vijaya karila — set forth; prabhu vishvambhara hari — the Lord Vishvambhara Hari

78When all had gathered and sankirtana began,
the Lord Vishvambhara Hari set forth.

নদিয়া-নগরে ভেল আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ।
গগনে উঠিয়া লাগে হরি হরি বোল ॥ ৭৯ ॥

nadiẏā-nagare bhela ānanda-hillola |
gagane uṭhiẏā lāge hari hari bola || 79 ||

nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; bhela ananda-hillola — waves of bliss arose; gagane uthiya lage — rising, reaches the sky; hari hari bola — the cry "Hari, Hari!"

79In the town of Nadia waves of bliss arose;
the cry "Hari, Hari!" rises to the sky.

নিজঘরে শুতিয়াছে জগাই মাধাই ।
নিজমদে মত্ত নিদ্রা যায় দুই ভাই ॥ ৮০ ॥

nijaghare śutiẏāche jagāi mādhāi |
nijamade matta nidrā yāẏa dui bhāi || 80 ||

nijaghare shutiyachhe — lie in their house; jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai; nija-made matta — drunk on their liquor; nidra yaya dui bhai — the two brothers sleep

80Meanwhile Jagai and Madhai lie in their house:
drunk on their liquor, both brothers sleep.

সেই পথে কীর্তন করিয়া প্রভু যায় ।
নদিয়ার লোক সব দেখিবারে ধায় ॥ ৮১ ॥

sei pathe kīrtana kariẏā prabhu yāẏa |
nadiẏāra loka saba dekhibāre dhāẏa || 81 ||

sei pathe — along that road; kirtana kariya prabhu yaya — the Lord goes performing kirtana; nadiyara loka saba — all the people of Nadia; dekhibare dhaya — run to see

81Along that very road the Lord goes performing kirtana,
and all the people of Nadia run to see.

করতাল-মৃদঙ্গাদি কীর্তনের রোলে ।
চতুর্দিগে শুনি মাত্র হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৮২ ॥

karatāla-mṛdaṅgādi kīrtanera role |
caturdige śuni mātra hari hari bole || 82 ||

karatala-mridangadi — karatalas, mridangas and the rest; kirtanera role — in the roar of kirtana; chaturdige shuni matra — on all sides one hears only; hari hari bole — "Hari, Hari!"

82In the roar of the kirtana — karatalas, mridangas and the rest —
on all sides one hears only "Hari, Hari!".

জাগিল সে দুই ভাই কীর্তনের রোলে ।
মুখ তুলি' চাহে ক্রোধে ধর্ ধর্ বোলে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

jāgila se dui bhāi kīrtanera role |
mukha tuli' cāhe krodhe dhar dhar bole || 83 ||

jagila se dui bhai — the two brothers awoke; kirtanera role — at the roar of the kirtana; mukha tuli chahe — raising their heads they look; krodhe dhar dhar bole — angrily shout "Seize, seize!"

83At the roar of the kirtana the two brothers awoke;
raising their heads they look and angrily shout: "Seize, seize!"

রাঙ্গা দু-নয়ন করি' চাহে ক্রোধ-দিঠি ।
কি না ধ্বনি শুনি কর্ণে মাইল যেন জাঠি ॥ ৮৪ ॥

rāṅgā du-naẏana kari' cāhe krodha-diṭhi |
ki nā dhbani śuni karṇe māila yena jāṭhi || 84 ||

ranga du-nayana kari — with both eyes reddened; chahe krodha-dithi — they glare in anger; ki na dhvani shuni — what noise is this we hear; karne maila yena jathi — as if a spear struck our ears

84With reddened eyes they glare in anger:
"What noise is this we hear? As if a spear had struck our ears!

হৃদয়ের শেল যেন একটি শবদ ।
জীতে সাধ থাকে যদি হউ নিঃশবদ ॥ ৮৫ ॥

hṛdaẏera śela yena ekaṭi śabada |
jīte sādha thāke yadi hau niḥśabada || 85 ||

hridayera shela yena — like a spear in the heart; ekati shabada — every single sound; jite sadha thake yadi — if they wish to live; hau nihshabada — let them be silent

85Every sound is like a spear in the heart.
If they value their lives, let them be silent!"

তাহার কাছের লোক কহে তার আগে ।
সম্বরণ কর গোসাঞি ক্রোধ কর কাকে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

tāhāra kāchera loka kahe tāra āge |
sambaraṇa kara gosāñi krodha kara kāke || 86 ||

tahara kachhera loka — their attendants; kahe tara age — say before them; samvarana kara gosanyi — restrain yourselves, masters; krodha kara kake — at whom are you angry

86Their attendants say to them:
"Restrain yourselves, masters — with whom are you angry?

আজ্ঞা পাইলে যাব এখন নিষেধ করিব ।
কাহার শকতি আর এ পথে আসিব ॥ ৮৭ ॥

ājñā pāile yāba ekhana niṣedha kariba |
kāhāra śakati āra e pathe āsiba || 87 ||

ajna paile — if ordered; yaba ekhana — we will go now; nishedha kariba — we will forbid them; kahara shakati — who would dare; ara e pathe asiba — to come this way again

87Give the order and we will go at once and forbid them;
who would then dare to come this way again?

জগন্নাথ-সুত দ্বিজ নিমাই-পণ্ডিত ।
কীর্তন করয়ে সব-ব্রাহ্মণ-বেষ্টিত ॥ ৮৮ ॥

jagannātha-suta dbija nimāi-paṇḍita |
kīrtana karaẏe saba-brāhmaṇa-beṣṭita || 88 ||

jagannatha-suta dvija — the brahmana son of Jagannatha; nimai-pandita — Nimai Pandita; kirtana karaye — performs kirtana; saba-brahmana-veshtita — surrounded by brahmanas

88It is Jagannatha's son, the brahmana Nimai Pandita,
performing kirtana surrounded by brahmanas."

নিষেধ করহ তারা যাউ অন্যপথে ।
নিঃশবদে রহু যদি সাধ থাকে জীতে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

niṣedha karaha tārā yāu anyapathe |
niḥśabade rahu yadi sādha thāke jīte || 89 ||

nishedha karaha — forbid them; tara yau anyapathe — let them go another way; nihshabade rahu — let them be silent; yadi sadha thake jite — if they wish to live

89"Forbid them: let them go another way!
Let them be silent if they value their lives.

মিছা গোল করি' বুলে নাহি চিনে মূল ।
মোর হাথে হারাইবে জাতি প্রাণ কুল ॥ ৯০ ॥

michā gola kari' bule nāhi cine mūla |
mora hāthe hārāibe jāti prāṇa kula || 90 ||

michha gola kari bule — they go about making a pointless din; nahi chine mula — they do not know the root; mora hathe — at my hand; haraibe jati prana kula — they will lose caste, life and family

90They go about making a pointless din, not knowing the root of things —
at my hand they will lose caste, life and family!"

ইহা বলি' পাঠাইল আপনার দূত ।
কহিল ঠাকুর-আগে শুনে শচীসুত ॥ ৯১ ॥

ihā bali' pāṭhāila āpanāra dūta |
kahila ṭhākura-āge śune śacīsuta || 91 ||

iha bali — saying this; pathaila apanara duta — they sent their messenger; kahila thakura-age — [he] spoke before the Thakura; shune shachisuta — Shachi's son listens

91Saying this, they sent their messenger,
and he gave [their message] to the Thakura; Shachi's son listens —

অধিক করয়ে হরিনাম-সংকীর্তন ।
বাহু তুলি' হরি হরি বোলে ঘনে ঘন ॥ ৯২ ॥

adhika karaẏe harināma-saṃkīrtana |
bāhu tuli' hari hari bole ghane ghana || 92 ||

adhika karaye — [He] performs all the more; harinama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name; bahu tuli — raising His arms; hari hari bole ghane ghana — cries "Hari, Hari!" again and again

92and sings the sankirtana of Hari's name all the louder:
raising His arms, again and again He cries "Hari, Hari!".

দ্বিগুণ করিয়া প্রেম বাঢ়ায় উল্লাস ।
হরি হরি বোল-ধ্বনি পরশে আকাশ ॥ ৯৩ ॥

dbiguṇa kariẏā prema bāṛhāẏa ullāsa |
hari hari bola-dhbani paraśe ākāśa || 93 ||

dviguna kariya prema — doubling the prema; badhaya ullasa — He increases the exultation; hari hari bola-dhvani — the cry "Hari, Hari!"; parashe akasha — touches the sky

93Doubling the prema, He increases the exultation:
the cry "Hari, Hari!" touches the sky.

পাপিষ্ঠ হৃদয় তাহা সহিবারে নারে ।
চলিলা সে দুই ভাই বাহির-দুয়ারে ॥ ৯৪ ॥

pāpiṣṭha hṛdaẏa tāhā sahibāre nāre |
calilā se dui bhāi bāhira-duẏāre || 94 ||

papishtha hridaya — the sinful hearts; taha sahibare nare — cannot bear it; chalila se dui bhai — the two brothers went; bahira-duyare — to the outer gate

94The sinful hearts cannot bear it:
the two brothers went out to the outer gate.

ক্রোধে রাঙ্গা আঁখি তার অরুণ-বদন ।
পড়িতে পড়িতে যায় অঙ্গের বসন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

krodhe rāṅgā āṁkhi tāra aruṇa-badana |
paṛite paṛite yāẏa aṅgera basana || 95 ||

krodhe ranga ankhi — eyes red with anger; tara aruna-vadana — their faces crimson; padite padite — falling and falling; yaya angera vasana — their clothes slip off

95Their eyes red with anger, their faces crimson,
their clothes slipping again and again from their bodies.

টলবল করি' যায় ক্রোধে অচেতন ।
থাক্ থাক্ করি' বোলে তর্জন গর্জন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

ṭalabala kari' yāẏa krodhe acetana |
thāk thāk kari' bole tarjana garjana || 96 ||

talabala kari yaya — they go staggering; krodhe achetana — blind with anger; thak thak kari bole — shout "Stop, stop!"; tarjana garjana — with threats and roars

96Staggering, blind with anger, they go
and with threats and roars shout: "Stop, stop!"

রাঙ্গা দুনয়ন করি' বলে ক্রোধভরে ।
নাশিব বৈষ্ণব সব নদীয়া নগরে ॥ ৯৬+১ ॥

rāṅgā dunaẏana kari' bale krodhabhare |
nāśiba baiṣṇaba saba nadīẏā nagare || 96+1 ||

ranga dunayana kari — reddening both eyes; bale krodha-bhare — shout in anger; nashiba — we will destroy; vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas; nadiya nagare — in the town of Nadia

96+1Their eyes red, they shout in anger:
"We will destroy all the Vaishnavas in the town of Nadia!"12

সম্মুখে দাঁড়াঞা তারা চারিপানে চায় ।
আপনা চিনিয়া যাহ বড় ডাকে কয় ॥ ৯৭ ॥

sammukhe dāṁṛāñā tārā cāripāne cāẏa |
āpanā ciniẏā yāha baṛa ḍāke kaẏa || 97 ||

sammukhe dandanya — standing in front; tara charipane chaya — they look all around; apana chiniya yaha — know your place and go; bada dake kaya — they shout loudly

97Standing in front, they look all around
and shout loudly: "Know your place — get out!

আরে রে বামনা তোর জীতে লাগে শনি ।
ইহা বলি' দুর্বাক্য-বচনে পাড়ে গালি ॥ ৯৮ ॥

āre re bāmanā tora jīte lāge śani |
ihā bali' durbākya-bacane pāṛe gāli || 98 ||

are re bamana — hey you, wretched brahmana; tora jite lage shani — Shani hangs over your life; iha bali — saying this; durvakya-bachane pade gali — they hurl foul abuse

98Hey you, wretched brahmana, Shani hangs over your life!" —
and with these words they hurl foul abuse.13

ক্রোধ দেখি' নদিয়ার লোক তরাসিত ।
চারিপানে চাহি' সভে হৈলা ভীতাভীত ॥ ৯৯ ॥

krodha dekhi' nadiẏāra loka tarāsita |
cāripāne cāhi' sabhe hailā bhītābhīta || 99 ||

krodha dekhi — seeing the anger; nadiyara loka tarasita — the people of Nadia are terrified; charipane chahi — looking around; sabhe haila bhitabhita — all were frightened

99Seeing their anger, the people of Nadia were frightened:
looking around, all were terrified.

তর্জিয়া গর্জিয়া তবে দুই ভাই চলে ।
বাহু তুলি' ভক্তগণ হরি হরি বলে ॥ ৯৯+১ ॥

tarjiẏā garjiẏā tabe dui bhāi cale |
bāhu tuli' bhaktagaṇa hari hari bale || 99+1 ||

tarjiya garjiya — threatening and roaring; tabe dui bhai chale — then the two brothers move on; bahu tuli — raising their arms; bhakta-gana hari hari bale — the devotees cry "Hari, Hari"

99+1Threatening and roaring, the brothers moved on,
while the devotees, raising their arms, cry: "Hari, Hari!"14

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি আর নিত্যানন্দ ।
হরিদাস শ্রীনিবাস মুরারি মুকুন্দ ॥ ১০০ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi āra nityānanda |
haridāsa śrīnibāsa murāri mukunda || 100 ||

advaita-acharya-gosanyi ara nityananda — Advaita Acharya Gosani and Nityananda; haridasa shrinivasa murari mukunda — Haridasa, Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda

100Advaita Acharya Gosani and Nityananda,
Haridasa, Srinivasa, Murari, Mukunda —

আপনে ঠাকুর সেই বিশ্বম্ভর-রায় ।
নিজগণ সঙ্গে করি' হরিগুণ গায় ॥ ১০১ ॥

āpane ṭhākura sei biśbambhara-rāẏa |
nijagaṇa saṅge kari' hariguṇa gāẏa || 101 ||

apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; sei vishvambhara-raya — Vishvambhara-raya; nijagana sange kari — with His associates; hari-guna gaya — sings Hari's qualities

101and the Thakura Himself, Vishvambhara-raya,
together with His associates, sings Hari's qualities.

দ্বিগুণ করিয়া গায় বাঢ়ায় উল্লাস ।
হরি হরি বোল ধ্বনি পরশে আকাশ ॥ ১০১+১ ॥

dbiguṇa kariẏā gāẏa bāṛhāẏa ullāsa |
hari hari bola dhbani paraśe ākāśa || 101+1 ||

dviguna kariya gaya — sing twice as strongly; badhaya ullasa — increase the jubilation; hari hari bola dhvani — the cry "Hari, Hari"; parashe akasha — touches the sky

101+1They sing with redoubled strength, increasing the jubilation:
the cry "Hari, Hari!" touches the sky15.

হরিগুণ গায় সুখে নাহি অবসাদ ।
জগাই মাধাই ক্রোধে করে পরমাদ ॥ ১০২ ॥

hariguṇa gāẏa sukhe nāhi abasāda |
jagāi mādhāi krodhe kare paramāda || 102 ||

hari-guna gaya sukhe — happily they sing Hari's qualities; nahi avasada — without weariness; jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai; krodhe kare paramada — in anger make mischief

102Happily, without weariness, they sing Hari's qualities,
while Jagai and Madhai in anger make mischief.

হরিনাম দুই ভাই সহিবারে নারে ।
বেগেতে ধাইল তারা ভক্ত মারিবারে ॥ ১০২+১ ॥

harināma dui bhāi sahibāre nāre |
begete dhāila tārā bhakta māribāre || 102+1 ||

hari-nama — the name of Hari; dui bhai sahibare nare — the two brothers cannot bear; begete dhaila tara — they rushed headlong; bhakta maribare — to beat the devotees

102+1The two brothers cannot bear the name of Hari:
they rushed headlong to beat the devotees16.

দীন-দয়ার্দ্র-চিত্ত নিত্যানন্দ রায় ।
অশ্রুপূর্ণ লোচনেতে দোঁহা পানে চায় ॥ ১০২+২ ॥

dīna-daẏārdra-citta nityānanda rāẏa |
aśrupūrṇa locanete doṁhā pāne cāẏa || 102+2 ||

dina-dayardra-chitta — whose heart melts with compassion for the wretched; nityananda raya — Nityananda Raya; ashrupurna lochanete — with eyes full of tears; donha pane chaya — looks at the two

102+2Nityananda Raya, whose heart melts with compassion for the wretched,
looks at the two of them with eyes full of tears.

সে করুণ আঁখি দেখি' পাপী না গলিল ।
তবে ত সম্মুখে নিতাই গৌর দাঁড়াইল ॥ ১০২+৩ ॥

se karuṇa āṁkhi dekhi' pāpī nā galila |
tabe ta sammukhe nitāi gaura dāṁṛāila || 102+3 ||

se karuna ankhi dekhi — seeing those compassionate eyes; papi na galila — the sinners did not soften; tabe ta sammukhe — then before [them]; nitai gaura dandaila — Nitai and Gaura stood

102+3But even seeing those compassionate eyes the sinners did not soften;
then Nitai and Gaura stood before them.

দেখি' জগাইর মন গেল দরবিয়া ।
দাঁড়ায়ে রহিল জগা স্তম্ভিত হৈয়া ॥ ১০২+৪ ॥

dekhi' jagāira mana gela darabiẏā |
dāṁṛāẏe rahila jagā stambhita haiẏā || 102+4 ||

dekhi — seeing; jagaira mana gela daraviya — Jagai's heart melted; dandaye rahila jaga — Jagai stood still; stambhita haiya — stupefied

102+4At the sight [of Them] Jagai's heart melted:
Jagai stood rooted to the spot.

ক্রোধে দুই ভাই ধায় করে করি' দণ্ড ।
সম্মুখে পাইল ভাঙ্গা কুম্ভ একখণ্ড ॥ ১০৩ ॥

krodhe dui bhāi dhāẏa kare kari' daṇḍa |
sammukhe pāila bhāṅgā kumbha ekakhaṇḍa || 103 ||

krodhe dui bhai dhaya — in anger both brothers run; kare kari danda — with sticks in hand; sammukhe paila — in front they found; bhanga kumbha ekakhanda — a shard of a broken pot

103In anger both brothers run with sticks in their hands
and find before them a shard of a broken pot.

কলসীর কাণা সে ফেলিয়া মারে ক্রোধে ।
নির্ভরে বাজিল নিত্যানন্দের মস্তকে ॥ ১০৪ ॥

kalasīra kāṇā se pheliẏā māre krodhe |
nirbhare bājila nityānandera mastake || 104 ||

kalasira kana — the rim of the [broken] pot; se pheliya mare krodhe — they hurl in anger; nirbhare bajila — it struck hard; nityanandera mastake — on Nityananda's head

104In anger they hurl that rim of the pot —
and it struck Nityananda's head with full force.

নির্ভরে বাজিল কাণা রক্ত পড়ে ধারে ।
দেখি' সর্ব নিজজন হাহাকার করে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

nirbhare bājila kāṇā rakta paṛe dhāre |
dekhi' sarba nijajana hāhākāra kare || 105 ||

nirbhare bajila kana — the shard struck hard; rakta pade dhare — blood flows in a stream; dekhi sarva nijajana — seeing it, all His own; hahakara kare — cry out in dismay

105The shard struck with full force, blood flows in a stream;
seeing it, all [the Lord's] own cry out in dismay.17

ফাটিল মুটকী শিরে ব্যথা নাহি গণে ।
গৌর বলি' নাচে নিতাই হরষিত মনে ॥ ১০৫+১ ॥

phāṭila muṭakī śire byathā nāhi gaṇe |
gaura bali' nāce nitāi haraṣita mane || 105+1 ||

phatila mutaki shire — the shard split His head; byatha nahi gane — takes no note of the pain; gaura bali — crying "Gaura"; nache nitai — Nitai dances; harashita mane — with a rejoicing heart

105+1His head is split by the shard, but He takes no note of the pain:
crying "Gaura!", Nitai dances with a rejoicing heart18.

মারিলি কলসীর কাণা সহিবারে পারি ।
তোদের দুর্গতি আমি সহিবারে নারি ॥ ১০৫+২ ॥

mārili kalasīra kāṇā sahibāre pāri |
todera durgati āmi sahibāre nāri || 105+2 ||

marili — you struck; kalasira kana — with the rim of a pot; sahibare pari — I can bear; todera durgati — your evil plight; ami sahibare nari — I cannot bear

105+2"You struck me with the rim of a pot — that I can bear,
but your evil plight I cannot bear.

মারিলি মারিলি ভাল তাহে ক্ষতি নাই ।
সুমধুর হরিনাম মুখে বল ভাই ॥ ১০৫+৩ ॥

mārili mārili bhāla tāhe kṣati nāi |
sumadhura harināma mukhe bala bhāi || 105+3 ||

marili marili bhala — you struck, well and good; tahe kshati nai — no harm in that; sumadhura hari-nama — the sweetest name of Hari; mukhe bala bhai — utter with your lips, brothers

105+3You struck me — well and good, no harm in that;
only utter with your lips the sweetest name of Hari, brothers!"

নিত্যানন্দ-সর্ব-অঙ্গে রক্ত পড়ে ধারে ।
পরমানন্দে নিত্যানন্দ গৌরাঙ্গ নেহারে ॥ ১০৫+৪ ॥

nityānanda-sarba-aṅge rakta paṛe dhāre |
paramānande nityānanda gaurāṅga nehāre || 105+4 ||

nityananda-sarva-ange — over all Nityananda's body; rakta pade dhare — blood streams; paramanande — in supreme bliss; nityananda gauranga nehare — Nityananda gazes at Gauranga

105+4Blood streams over all of Nityananda's body,
and Nityananda in supreme bliss gazes at Gauranga.

প্রেমভরে মহাপ্রভু নিতাই কোলে নিল ।
আপন বসন দিয়া রক্ত মুছাইল ॥ ১০৫+৫ ॥

premabhare mahāprabhu nitāi kole nila |
āpana basana diẏā rakta muchāila || 105+5 ||

prema-bhare — overflowing with love; mahaprabhu nitai kole nila — Mahaprabhu embraced Nitai; apana basana diya — with His own cloth; rakta muchhaila — wiped away the blood

105+5Overflowing with love, Mahaprabhu embraced Nitai
and wiped away the blood with His own cloth.

দেখিয়া ঠাকুর চিত্তে বড় পাইল দুখ ।
ডাকিয়া কহিল সেই পাপিষ্ঠ-সম্মুখ ॥ ১০৬ ॥

dekhiẏā ṭhākura citte baṛa pāila dukha |
ḍākiẏā kahila sei pāpiṣṭha-sammukha || 106 ||

dekhiya thakura — seeing it, the Thakura; chitte bada paila dukha — felt great sorrow at heart; dakiya kahila — called out; sei papishtha-sammukha — before those sinners

106Seeing it, the Thakura was deeply grieved at heart
and called out, [standing] before those sinners:

তোমরা দোঁহার অধিক দুরাচার নাহি ।
পাপ বলি' যার নাম সঞ্চারয়ে মহী ॥ ১০৭ ॥

tomarā doṁhāra adhika durācāra nāhi |
pāpa bali' yāra nāma sañcāraẏe mahī || 107 ||

tomara donhara adhika — more than you two; durachara nahi — there are none so wicked; papa bali — as "sin"; yara nama sancharaye mahi — whose name the earth spreads

107"There are none more wicked than you two:
the earth spreads your names as the very name of sin.

সকল করিলা মাত্র নাহি কর এক ।
এখনে করিলে সেই দেখ পরতেক ॥ ১০৮ ॥

sakala karilā mātra nāhi kara eka |
ekhane karile sei dekha parateka || 108 ||

sakala karila — you have done everything; matra nahi kara eka — only one thing you had not done; ekhane karile sei — now you have done that too; dekha parateka — see it plainly

108You had done everything but one thing —
and now you have done that too; see it plainly!"19

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু নিত্যানন্দ-কাছে ।
আপন বসন তাঁর শিরে বান্ধিয়াছে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

ihā bali' mahāprabhu nityānanda-kāche |
āpana basana tāṁra śire bāndhiẏāche || 109 ||

iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu nityananda-kachhe — Mahaprabhu, [going] to Nityananda; apana vasana — with His own cloth; tanra shire bandhiyachhe — bound His head

109Saying this, Mahaprabhu went to Nityananda
and bound His head with His own cloth.

নিত্যানন্দ-শ্রীপাদের জানেন মহত্ত্ব ।
ভূমিতে পড়য়ে পাছে তাঁহার রকত ॥ ১১০ ॥

nityānanda-śrīpādera jānena mahattba |
bhūmite paṛaẏe pāche tāṁhāra rakata || 110 ||

nityananda-shripadera — of Nityananda Shripada; janena mahattva — He knows the greatness; bhumite padaye pachhe — lest it fall on the ground; tanhara rakata — His blood

110He knows the greatness of Nityananda Shripada:
lest His blood fall on the ground —

পৃথিবীর অমঙ্গল জানি পাছে হয় ।
মস্তকে বান্ধিল বস্ত্র প্রভু এই ভয় ॥ ১১১ ॥

pṛthibīra amaṅgala jāni pāche haẏa |
mastake bāndhila bastra prabhu ei bhaẏa || 111 ||

prithivira amangala — misfortune to the earth; jani pachhe haya — knowing it might come; mastake bandhila vastra — bound the cloth on the head; prabhu ei bhaya — the Lord, fearing this

111knowing that misfortune would then befall the earth —
the Lord, fearing this, bound His head with the cloth.20

তখনে সে মহাপ্রভুর ক্রোধ উপজিল ।
সুদর্শন চক্র বলি' স্মরণ করিল ॥ ১১১+১ ॥

takhane se mahāprabhura krodha upajila |
sudarśana cakra bali' smaraṇa karila || 111+1 ||

takhane — then; se mahaprabhura krodha upajila — anger arose in Mahaprabhu; sudarshana chakra bali — saying "Sudarshana-chakra"; smarana karila — called to mind

111+1Then anger arose in Mahaprabhu,
and He called [His disc] to mind, crying: "Sudarshana-chakra!"21

সুদর্শন বলি' প্রভু ডাকে বার বার ।
শুনিয়া মুরারি গুপ্ত ছাড়য়ে হুঙ্কার ॥ ১১১+২ ॥

sudarśana bali' prabhu ḍāke bāra bāra |
śuniẏā murāri gupta chāṛaẏe huṅkāra || 111+2 ||

sudarshana bali — crying "Sudarshana"; prabhu dake bara bara — the Lord calls again and again; shuniya — hearing; murari gupta chhadaye hunkara — Murari Gupta gives a roar

111+2"Sudarshana!" — the Lord calls again and again;
hearing this, Murari Gupta gives a thunderous roar

শুনিয়া কহয়ে শুন প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
আজ্ঞা পাঙ এ দুই পাঠাঙ যম-ঘর ॥ ১১১+৩ ॥

śuniẏā kahaẏe śuna prabhu biśbambhara |
ājñā pāṅa e dui pāṭhāṅa yama-ghara || 111+3 ||

shuniya kahaye — hearing, he says; shuna prabhu vishvambhara — listen, Lord Vishvambhara; ajna pana — let me get the order; e dui pathana yama-ghara — I send these two to the abode of Yama

111+3and says: "Listen, Lord Vishvambhara:
give me the order — I will send these two to the abode of Yama!"

শুনি' নিত্যানন্দ ধরেন মুরারির হাতে ।
হেনকালে সুদর্শন আইলা সাক্ষাতে ॥ ১১১+৪ ॥

śuni' nityānanda dharena murārira hāte |
henakāle sudarśana āilā sākṣāte || 111+4 ||

shuni — hearing; nityananda dharena murarira hate — Nityananda holds Murari by the hand; henakale — at that moment; sudarshana aila sakshate — Sudarshana appeared in person

111+4Hearing this, Nityananda holds Murari back by the hand —
and at that moment Sudarshana appeared in person.

ক্রোধ করি' সুদর্শনে ডাকে গৌরহরি ।
দাণ্ডাইলা সুদর্শন করযোড় করি' ॥ ১১২ ॥

krodha kari' sudarśane ḍāke gaurahari |
dāṇḍāilā sudarśana karayoṛa kari' || 112 ||

krodha kari — in anger; sudarshane dake gaurahari — Gaurahari summons Sudarshana; dandaila sudarshana — Sudarshana stood forth; karajoda kari — with joined palms

112In anger Gaurahari summons Sudarshana,
and Sudarshana stood [before Him] with joined palms:

কি কারণে আজ্ঞা মোরে করিলা ঈশ্বর ।
জয় জয় মহাপ্রভু শচীর কোঙর ॥ ১১৩ ॥

ki kāraṇe ājñā more karilā īśbara |
jaẏa jaẏa mahāprabhu śacīra koṅara || 113 ||

ki karane — for what reason; ajna more karila ishvara — has the Ishvara summoned me; jaya jaya mahaprabhu — glory, glory to Mahaprabhu; shachira kongara — the son of Shachi

113"Why, O Ishvara, have You summoned me?
Glory, glory to Mahaprabhu, the son of Shachi!"

প্রভু বোলে জগাই-মাধাইরে সংহার ।
নিত্যানন্দ মারি' ব্যথা দিলেক অন্তর ॥ ১১৪ ॥

prabhu bole jagāi-mādhāire saṃhāra |
nityānanda māri' byathā dileka antara || 114 ||

prabhu bole — the Lord says; jagai-madhaire samhara — destroy Jagai and Madhai; nityananda mari — striking Nityananda; vyatha dileka antara — they have pained [My] heart

114The Lord says: "Destroy Jagai and Madhai:
by striking Nityananda they have wounded My heart."

শুনি' সুদর্শন অতি প্রলয় হইয়া ।
জগাই মাধাই-পাশে চলিলা ধাইয়া ॥ ১১৫ ॥

śuni' sudarśana ati pralaẏa haiẏā |
jagāi mādhāi-pāśe calilā dhāiẏā || 115 ||

shuni sudarshana — hearing, Sudarshana; ati pralaya haiya — terrible as the world's dissolution; jagai madhai-pashe — towards Jagai and Madhai; chalila dhaiya — rushed

115Hearing this, Sudarshana, terrible as the world's dissolution,
rushed towards Jagai and Madhai.

দেখিলেন জগাই মাধাই সুদর্শন ।
কাঁপিতে লাগিল অঙ্গ তরাসিত মন ॥ ১১৬ ॥

dekhilena jagāi mādhāi sudarśana |
kāṁpite lāgila aṅga tarāsita mana || 116 ||

dekhilena jagai madhai — Jagai and Madhai saw; sudarshana — Sudarshana; kapite lagila anga — their bodies began to tremble; tarasita mana — their minds terrified

116Jagai and Madhai saw Sudarshana:
their bodies began to tremble, their minds were seized with fear.

সুদর্শন দেখি' নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু হাসে ।
কি করিলা ভগবান্ এ বড় প্রকাশে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

sudarśana dekhi' nityānanda prabhu hāse |
ki karilā bhagabān e baṛa prakāśe || 117 ||

sudarshana dekhi — seeing Sudarshana; nityananda prabhu hase — Nityananda Prabhu laughs; ki karila bhagavan — what has Bhagavan done; e bada prakashe — with this great manifestation

117Seeing Sudarshana, Nityananda Prabhu laughs:
"What has Bhagavan done — what a great manifestation!"

দয়ার সাগর মোর নিত্যানন্দ রায় ।
না মারিহ বলি' সুদর্শনে নিবারয় ॥ ১১৭+১ ॥

daẏāra sāgara mora nityānanda rāẏa |
nā māriha bali' sudarśane nibāraẏa || 117+1 ||

dayara sagara — an ocean of mercy; mora nityananda raya — my Nityananda Raya; na mariha bali — saying "do not kill"; sudarshane nivaraya — holds Sudarshana back

117+1My Nityananda Raya is an ocean of mercy:
"Do not kill!" He says, and holds Sudarshana back22.

করুণাতে উদ্ধার করিলা ত্রিভুবন ।
দীনহীন পতিত পামর দুষ্টজন ॥ ১১৮ ॥

karuṇāte uddhāra karilā tribhubana |
dīnahīna patita pāmara duṣṭajana || 118 ||

karunate — out of compassion; uddhara karila tribhuvana — You have delivered the three worlds; dinahina — the poor and lowly; patita pamara dushtajana — the fallen, the vile, the wicked

118"In Your compassion You have delivered the three worlds —
the poor and lowly, the fallen, the vile and the wicked.

জগাই মাধাই তারি' দীনবন্ধু হও ।
পতিতপাবন-নামের গরিমা রাখহ ॥ ১১৯ ॥

jagāi mādhāi tāri' dīnabandhu hao |
patitapābana-nāmera garimā rākhaha || 119 ||

jagai madhai tari — delivering Jagai and Madhai; dinabandhu hao — be the Friend of the wretched; patitapavana-namera — of the name "Purifier of the fallen"; garima rakhaha — keep the glory

119Deliver Jagai and Madhai — be the Friend of the wretched,
keep the glory of the name 'Purifier of the fallen'."

ইহা বলি' নিত্যানন্দ চরণে পড়িয়া ।
কহিলেন প্রভু-পদে বিনয় করিয়া ॥ ১২০ ॥

ihā bali' nityānanda caraṇe paṛiẏā |
kahilena prabhu-pade binaẏa kariẏā || 120 ||

iha bali — saying this; nityananda charane padiya — Nityananda, falling at the feet; kahilena prabhu-pade — spoke at the Lord's feet; vinaya kariya — humbly

120Saying this, Nityananda fell at His feet
and spoke humbly at the Lord's feet:

এ দুই পতিত প্রভু মোরে কর দান ।
পতিতপাবন-নাম থাকুক ব্যাখ্যান ॥ ১২১ ॥

e dui patita prabhu more kara dāna |
patitapābana-nāma thākuka byākhyāna || 121 ||

e dui patita — these two fallen ones; prabhu more kara dana — Lord, give to me; patitapavana-nama — the name "Purifier of the fallen"; thakuka vyakhyana — let it remain renowned

121"Lord, give these two fallen ones to me:
let the name 'Purifier of the fallen' be renowned.

আর আর যুগে দৈত্য করিলে সংহার ।
সশরীরে এই দুই করহ উদ্ধার ॥ ১২২ ॥

āra āra yuge daitya karile saṃhāra |
saśarīre ei dui karaha uddhāra || 122 ||

ara ara yuge — in other ages; daitya karile samhara — You destroyed the demons; sasharire — in their very bodies; ei dui karaha uddhara — deliver these two

122In other ages You destroyed the demons —
deliver these two in their very bodies23.

করজোড়ি' প্রভুরে বোলয়ে নিত্যানন্দ ।
নাহি লো নিস্তার কলি-পাষণ্ড দুরন্ত ॥ ১২২+১ ॥

karajoṛi' prabhure bolaẏe nityānanda |
nāhi lo nistāra kali-pāṣaṇḍa duranta || 122+1 ||

karajodi — with joined palms; prabhure bolaye nityananda — Nityananda says to the Lord; nahi lo nistara — there is no deliverance; kali-pashanda duranta — the godless of Kali are untamable

122+1With joined palms Nityananda says to the Lord:
"[Otherwise] there is no deliverance: the godless of the Kali age are untamable24.

সংকীর্তন-আরম্ভে সে তোমার অবতার ।
কেমনে করিবে কলি-জীবের নিস্তার ॥ ১২২+২ ॥

saṃkīrtana-ārambhe se tomāra abatāra |
kemane karibe kali-jībera nistāra || 122+2 ||

sankirtana-arambhe — to begin sankirtana; se tomara avatara — is Your descent; kemane karibe — how will You accomplish; kali-jivera nistara — the deliverance of the souls of Kali

122+2You descended to begin sankirtana —
how [else] will You deliver the souls of the Kali age?"

শুনি' নিত্যানন্দ-বাণী প্রভু দয়াময় ।
ধন্য ধন্য নিত্যানন্দ রোহিণী-তনয় ॥ ১২৩ ॥

śuni' nityānanda-bāṇī prabhu daẏāmaẏa |
dhanya dhanya nityānanda rohiṇī-tanaẏa || 123 ||

shuni nityananda-vani — hearing Nityananda's words; prabhu dayamaya — the merciful Lord [says]; dhanya dhanya nityananda — blessed, blessed is Nityananda; rohini-tanaya — the son of Rohini

123Hearing Nityananda's words, the merciful Lord [says]:
"Blessed, blessed is Nityananda, the son of Rohini!"25

প্রভু বলে নিত্যানন্দ পতিতপাবন ।
তোমারে ভজিলে জীব পায় প্রেমধন ॥ ১২৩+১ ॥

prabhu bale nityānanda patitapābana |
tomāre bhajile jība pāẏa premadhana || 123+1 ||

prabhu bale — the Lord says; nityananda patita-pavana — Nityananda, Purifier of the fallen; tomare bhajile — worshipping You; jiva paya prema-dhana — living beings obtain the treasure of prema

123+1The Lord says: "Nityananda, You are the Purifier of the fallen:
worshipping You, living beings obtain the treasure of prema26.

তোমা হৈতে হবে কলি-জীবের নিস্তার ।
তোমা বহি কৃপার সমুদ্র নাহি আর ॥ ১২৩+২ ॥

tomā haite habe kali-jībera nistāra |
tomā bahi kṛpāra samudra nāhi āra || 123+2 ||

toma haite — through You; habe kali-jivera nistara — will come the deliverance of the souls of Kali; toma bahi — apart from You; kripara samudra nahi ara — there is no other ocean of mercy

123+2Through You will come the deliverance of the souls of Kali;
apart from You there is no [other] ocean of mercy.

তোর বশ মুঞি হও সর্বশাস্ত্রে কহে ।
যে তুমি কহিলে তাহা করিব নিশ্চয়ে ॥ ১২৪ ॥

tora baśa muñi hao sarbaśāstre kahe |
ye tumi kahile tāhā kariba niścaẏe || 124 ||

tora basha munyi hao — I am under Your control; sarva-shastre kahe — all the scriptures say; ye tumi kahile — what You have said; taha kariba nishchaye — I will surely do

124All the scriptures say that I am under Your control:
what You have said I will surely do.

একবার নিত্যানন্দ বোলে জন্ম ধরি' ।
সে জন পবিত্র হৈল সে লোক আমারি ॥ ১২৫ ॥

ekabāra nityānanda bole janma dhari' |
se jana pabitra haila se loka āmāri || 125 ||

ekabara — even once; nityananda bole — says "Nityananda"; janma dhari — having taken birth; se jana pavitra haila — that person is purified; se loka amari — that person is Mine

125Whoever, having taken birth, even once says 'Nityananda'
is purified — that person is Mine."

ঘরে গেলা মহাপ্রভু নিজজন লঞা ।
জগাই মাধাই রহে বিস্মিত হইয়া ॥ ১২৬ ॥

ghare gelā mahāprabhu nijajana lañā |
jagāi mādhāi rahe bismita haiẏā || 126 ||

ghare gela mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu went home; nijajana lanya — with His own; jagai madhai rahe — Jagai and Madhai remained; vismita haiya — astonished

126Mahaprabhu went home with His own,
and Jagai and Madhai remained, astonished.

✦

Notes

  1. The summary covers the whole section (vv. 1–169); this portion contains vv. 1–126, the rest is in the next. In the OCR of the edition many places are garbled or illegible (part of the summary ended up among the verses); what is restored by sense is in square brackets. Cf. Murari 2.10 and 2.13; Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya 13; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17.
  2. Vv. 2+1 — 2+7 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in the main text. Cf. Murari 2.10.16–17, where this play is understood as a repetition of Krishna's play with the gopis' garments; here it is the Lord's playful sport with His intimates, in which He, "who knows every rasa", gives them joy.
  3. Vv. 5–23 — cf. Murari 2.10.18–21. Nityananda's swaying gait, red eyes and loud cries are signs of His intoxication with prema (cf. en/28, note 12). The washing of His feet at the Lord's command teaches honour to the Vaishnava: the water of a devotee's feet purifies and bestows prema.
  4. In the 1983 edition this couplet stands after Advaita's arrival (vv. 29–30), and the honours and the meal refer to Him (cf. v. 34); in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition it comes before His arrival, so that they may also be referred to Haridasa (cf. Murari 2.10.4, where the Lord feeds Haridasa mahaprasada). We keep the order of the edition.
  5. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, Brahma and Prahlada are united in Haridasa Thakura (Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika); here Brahma manifests in him and praises the Lord with four mouths. Cf. Murari 2.10.24.
  6. Vv. 36–41 — the reasons for the Lord's descent: to taste His own bhava and to establish the dharma of the age, the sankirtana of the name (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3–4, where the inner reason is to taste Radha's love, and the outer one to spread the holy name and the prema of Vraja). Cf. Gita 4.8 on "destroying irreligion and establishing dharma".
  7. Vv. 43–46 — a list of associates; the presence of Narahari and Raghunandana, as above (en/29, note 7), is mentioned only by Lochana Dasa.
  8. "Tying it fast" — literally "making a knot (granthi)": perhaps counting the names on knots of a string is also meant.
  9. "Masters (thakuras) of Navadvipa" — according to the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 13), Jagai and Madhai, brothers of a noble brahmana family, were the town's keepers of order (kotwals) and were sunk in vice.
  10. V. 62+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it in a footnote as an additional reading of one printed book. Kayasthas are the caste of scribes. Cf. en/31, v. 148+1.
  11. The story of Ajamila is Bhagavata 6.1–2: the dying sinner called his son named Narayana, and even such an utterance of the name — namabhasa, the "shadow of the name", the name directed to another — saved him. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary stresses precisely this.
  12. V. 96+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
  13. Shani is Saturn, the planet-deity who brings misfortune; "Shani hangs over your life" is a threat: "you are done for".
  14. V. 99+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it).
  15. V. 101+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it); it nearly repeats v. 93.
  16. Vv. 102+1 — 102+4 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them). In the 1983 edition v. 103 also differs: "Madhai runs in anger with a stick in his hand", so that Madhai alone throws the shard, while Jagai, touched by Nityananda's gaze, stands rooted to the spot (see note 17).
  17. In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition both brothers throw the shard. According to the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 13), only Madhai struck Nityananda, while Jagai held him back from a second blow and was the first to receive mercy; the 1983 edition is close to this (vv. 102+1 — 102+4 and its reading of v. 103), and there, moreover, Nityananda, heedless of the pain, asks the brothers to sing the name of Hari (vv. 105+1 — 105+5). In Murari (2.13) the Lord promises to deliver Jagai and Madhai at Srivasa's request.
  18. Vv. 105+1 — 105+5 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them). Nityananda grieves not over His wound but over the evil plight of the offenders — an image of His unparalleled mercy (see note 23).
  19. That is, they have offended a saint — Nityananda, a sannyasi and a Vaishnava; offence to a Vaishnava (vaishnava-aparadha) is the gravest of sins.
  20. Nityananda is Balarama, the Lord Himself (Sankarshana, the source of Ananta-Shesha); to spill His blood on the earth is a great offence that threatens the world with calamity.
  21. Vv. 111+1 — 111+4 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them). Murari Gupta, according to Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, is Hanuman (en/24, note 12) — hence his warlike roar.
  22. V. 117+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it); these are the author's words inserted into Nityananda's speech.
  23. The Lord's anger at the offenders of His devotee is also a manifestation of His love; and in the age of Kali the Lord takes up no weapons, but delivers by the holy name and prema (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3, 17). Nityananda's intercession for His offenders is an image of His unparalleled mercy: according to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, Nityananda's grace makes no distinction between the worthy and the unworthy (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 5).
  24. Vv. 122+1 — 122+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them).
  25. The son of Rohini is Balarama; thus Lochana Dasa directly calls Nityananda Balarama, as does the whole Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition.
  26. Vv. 123+1 — 123+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks them). In the 1983 edition v. 123 itself also differs: "Hearing Nityananda's words, Lord Gaurachandra began to weep, embracing Nityananda"; and the words "Blessed, blessed is Nityananda, the son of Rohini" stand there after v. 125 as the author's exclamation: "Blessed, blessed is Gaurachandra, the merciful Lord; blessed, blessed is Nityananda, the son of Rohini!" According to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, it is by Nityananda's mercy that one obtains Gaura's mercy (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 5, 8).
